rationale: Exact-stack bounded matrix calibration is explicitly opt-in. Compatibility checks and synthetic ordering profiles validate admission and routing, not measured production profitability; no calibrated winner is shipped. Resource and restart identities preserve profile-path selection without reading the file during dry runs, while native preparation owns content compatibility and capture invalidation.
revisit_condition: Promote only after independently qualified RHF/UHF energy/force endpoints, matched cold/warm/moved-warm complete timings, semantic work counts and complete peak storage establish a measured source/stack/target/workload winner with bounded native fallback.
